question: Can changing lean_attack's seed provide the repeated-centre or paired-seed evidence missing from D452?
number: The executable calls rng_seed(seed), but assigns c from ci+1 and chooses j from j0 and ci. With other arguments fixed, changing seed cannot randomize the centre sequence. A different driver or algebraic proof is still required for independence; no score credit.
source: our workflow: D568 read-only Poseidon-r2 centre/seed source audit
held_fixed: checked-in lean_attack.c and command-line arguments; no writes
reopen_if: driver with explicit/randomized centre values and preregistered repeated-centre/paired-seed runs, or algebraic independence proof
